chapter.verse: Kote laka a tangtung khinsa thute, ciaptehna khat gelhkhia dingin mi tampi in hanciam khinzo a,
a kipatcil pan mit tawh a mute leh Pasian' thu a hilh nasemte in tua thute kote' kiangah hong gensawnsa uh ahih mah bangin
a zahtak-huai Theophilus aw, hih thute khempeuh a kipatcil pan limtak kancian khin ka hihna tawh kizui-in kei zong nang' ading ciaptehna kician khat kong gelhsak ding hoihtuak ka sa a,
tua pen nang hong kihilhsa thute ah lungmuanna na neih nading ahi hi.
Judea gam a uk Kumpi Herod a khan sungin Abijah' makaih siampi beelpawl sunga kihel Zechariah minnei siampi khat om hi. Aaron' suan numei khat zi-in nei a, a min Elizabeth ahi hi.
A nupa-un Pasian' mai-ah diktat uh a, Topa' thupiakte leh ngeinate khempeuh paubanna om lo-in zui uh hi.
Elizabeth ciing ahih manin ta nei lo uh a, a nihun zong teek ta uh hi.
Tu-in Zechariah pen ama' kihelna beelpawlte' sep hun tungin Pasian' mai-ah siampi vaipuak a lak laitak hi a,
siampi nasepna ah zatngeizia ahi aisanna tungtawnin Topa' biakinnpi sungah paknamtui hal dingin amah kiteel hi.
Paknamtui hal hun a tun ciangin mihonpi bup a pualam ah thungenin om uh hi.
Tua laitak ama' kiangah Topa' vanmi khat hong kilaak a, paknamtui biakpiaktau taklam pang ah ding hi.
Zechariah in a muh ciangin lungpatau a, launa tawh kidim hi.
Ahih hangin vanmi in, "Zechariah aw, lau kei in. A hang pen na thungetna hong kisang zo hi. Na zi Elizabeth in nang' ading tapa khat nei ding a, a min John na phuak ding hi.
Nuamna leh kipakna tawh na kidim ding a, mi tampite zong ama' hong suahna hangin lungdam ding uh hi.
A hang pen Topa' mai-ah amah milian hiding hi. Lengtui leh zu dawn ngeilo ding a, a nu' naubu sungpan nangawnin Kha Siangtho tawh kidim ding hi.
Amah in Israel mite tampitak amau' Pasian ahi Topa' kiangah kiheisak ding a,

pate' lungsim tate' lamah, thumanglo mite zong midikte' ciimna lampi ah a kiheisak dingin, leh Topa' ading minam a kibawlkhol khat a kigingsa-a koih dingin Elijah ii kha leh vangliatna tawh Topa' mai-ah amah hong pai ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Zechariah in vanmi' kiangah, "Hih thu bangci theih ding ka hi hiam? A hang pen putek khat ka hi a, ka zi zong khankum tam ta hi," ci hi.
Vanmi in, "Kei pen Pasian' mai-a a dingpa Gabriel ka hi hi. Nang hong hopihin hih Lungdamna Thu a ko dingin kei hong kisawl hi.
En in, a hun a cin ciangin a tangtung ding ahi ka thugente um lo na hih manin hih thute hong pian ni mateng pau theilo-in na daicip ding hi," ci hi.
Mite in Zechariah ngak uh a, biakinnpi sungah a ziakaina hangin lamdang sa uh hi.
Hong pusuah ciangin amaute hopih theilo ahih manin biakinnpi sungah muhtuamd khat nei ahihlam amaute in ngaihsun thei uh hi. Amah pau theilo suak ahih manin amaute' kiangah a pumpi tawh lim lak hi.
Ama' siampi nasep hun a bei ciangin a inn ah ciah hi.
Tua teng khit ciangin a zi Elizabeth gai-in kha nga sung amahmah kiseelcip a,
"Topa in kei hong et hun sungin mite laka ka maizumna hong hepkhiatsak nadingin kei' ading hih bangin hong sepsak khinzo hi," ci hi.
Kha gukna sungin Nazareth a kici Galilee gam khuapi khat ah a pai dingin Pasian' kiangpan vanmi Gabriel kisawl hi.
David' suan Joseph minnei pasal khat tawh zuthawl a kipia nungak khat' kianga pai ding hi a, nungaknu a min Mary ahi hi.
Amah hong pai-in nungaknu' kiangah, "Maipha ngahnu aw, na dam hiam? Topa in nang hong ompih hi! (Numeite lakah thuphangah na hi hi,)" ci hi.
Mary ahihleh tua hopihna hangin nakpi lungpatau a, bangci nam hiding cih thei nuamin ngaihsun hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi in, "Mary aw, lau kei in. A hang pen Pasian' maipha na muzo hi.
En in, na naubu sungah nau na paai ding a, tapa khat nei-in a min Jesu na phuak ding hi.
Amah milian hiding a, Sangpenpa' Tapa kici ding hi. Topa Pasian in ama' tungah a pa David ii kumpi-tokhom pia ding a,
Jacob innkuan' tungah amah mang tawntungin ama' kumpigam bei ngeilo ding hi," ci hi.
Mary in vanmi' kiangah, "Pasal tawh lumkhawm ngei nailo ka hih manin hih thu hong bangci pian ding ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Vanmi in, "Nang' tungah Kha Siangtho hong tung ding a, Sangpenpa' vangliatna in nang hong vuknelh ding hi. Tua hangin hong suak ding naungek zong a siangtho hiding a, Pasian' Tapa kici ding hi.
En in, na tanaunu Elizabeth zong a teek khitnung ah tapa khat paai a, a ciing a kici ngeinu pen tu-in a naupaai kha guk pha ta hi.
A hang pen Pasian' ading a piang theilo thu khat zong om lo hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mary in, "En in, kei pen Topa' silanu ka hi hi. Na genkhiat bangin kei' tungah hong piang ta hen," ci hi. Vanmi zong ama' kiangpan paikhia hi.
Tua hun sungin Mary kithawi a, Judah gam mualtung lama om khua khat ah nawhsa thu-in pai hi.
Zechariah' inn ah lutin Elizabeth hopih hi.
Elizabeth in Mary' hopihna a zak ciangin a naubu sunga naungek diang hi. Elizabeth zong Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin
nakpi kiko a, "Numeite lakah thuphangah na hi hi! Na naubu sunga naungek thuphangah ahi hi!
Kei' kiangah ka Topa' nu hong hawh nading hih hamphatna bang hangin ngah ka hi hiam?
A hang pen, en in, ka sunga naungek nakpi nuamna tawh diang hi.
Tua hi a, Topa' kiangpan ama' tunga kigen thu tangtung ding ci-a a um numei thuphangah ahi hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mary in hih bangin la sa hi: "Ka nunna kha in Topa liansak a,
ka kha zong ka Honpa Pasian' sungah gualnuam hi.
A hang pen amah in a silanu' tualniam dinmun hong muzo hi.
A hang pen vanglianpa in kei' ading naliante hong sepsak khinzo a, ama' min siangtho hi.
Amah a kihta mite' tungah a khangkhangin amah thukhual hi.
A khut tawh thahatna lakkhia khinzo a, lungsim kiliansakin a kiphasakte thehthang khinzo hi;
mi thahatteg amau' kumpi-tokhomte uh pan khiasuk khinzo a, tualniam mite laamto khinzo hi.
gilkialte nahoih tawh kidimsak khinzo a, mihaute a hawmguakin paikhiasak khinzo hi.
Amah in a thukhualna phawk a, ama' nasem Israel huh khinzo hi.
Tua pen i pu i pate' tungah a ciamsa hi a,
Elizabeth' kiangah kha thum bang a taam khit ciangin Mary a inn ah ciah hi.
Tu-in Elizabeth nausuah hun tung ta a, tapa khat a nei hi.
Ama' tungah Topa in thukhualna lianpi lak khinzo cih a vengte leh tanaute in a zak uh ciangin amah lungdampih uh hi.
Ni giat a cin ni-in naungek vun-at dingin amaute hong pai uh a, naungek' min dingin a pa' min Zechariah mah phuak nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin a nu in, "Hilo hi, amah John kici ding hi," ci hi.
Amaute in, "Na tanaute hih min tawh kilo khat beek om lo hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin a pa' kiangah bang min phuak nuam cih limlahna tawh dong uh hi.
Zechariah in laigelhna singbek khat ngen a, "Ama' min John ahi hi," ci-in gelh ahih manin amaute in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Tua khit phetin Zechariah a kam kihongin a leii kilok a, pau thei-in Pasian phat hi.
A vengte khempeuh zong launa tawh kidim uh a, Judea gam sung mualtung mun citeng ah hih thute genpi-in kinei hi.
Thu a za khempeuh in a lungsim sung uhah ciamteh uh a, "Hih naungek bangci mi hong hiding hiam?" ci uh hi. A hang pen Topa' khut in amah ompih hi.
Tua ciangin a pa Zechariah Kha Siangtho tawh kidim a, hih bangin kamsanna nei hi:
"Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen, a hang pen a mite' kiangah amah hawhin amaute khahkhia hi.
Amah in a nasempa David innkuan sungah eite' adingin hotkhiatna kih khat posak hi.
Tangtawng lai pekin ama' kamsang siangthote' kam zangin
i galte leh ei hong mudahte' khut pan hong hotkhiat ding thu gen khinzo hi.
Tua pen i pu i pate' tungah thukhualna a lak hi a, ama' thuciamna siangtho a phawk man ahi hi.
I pa Abraham' tungah piak dinga a ciamsa mah bangin
galte' khut sungpan hong kihonkhia eite in launa om lo-in ama' na a sem,
i khansung tawntung ama' mai-ah sianthona leh diktatna neih nading ahi hi.
Tua ciangin naupangno aw, nang pen Sangpenpa' kamsangpa hong kici ding hi; a hang pen Topa' mai-ah nang na mapai khol ding a, ama' lampite a bawlkhol ding leh
ama' mite a mawhna uh a kimaisakna tungtawnin amau' tungah hotkhiatna thu a theisak ding na hi hi.
Tua pen i Pasian ii lainat thukhualna hang hi a, a sangna mun pan tungsunni eite' kiangah hong hawh ding hi.
Tua pen khuamial leh sihna liim sunga tu mite' kiangah khuavak hong piak nading, leh i khete nopna lemna lampi hong totsak nading, ahi hi."
Naupang khanglian toto-in a lungsim thahat toto a, Israel mipilak a kilaak hun ma dong gamgawtak lakah om hi.Jesu Khris A Suahna Thu
